title: getAttributeGroupData request
description: Read a group's field values for one customer. Read the field values of one group for one domain entity. Reads the field-value store (note: a value written via updateCustomerField lands in the classification store and will NOT appear here — read it back via searchCustomerField). Returns a 'group' object whose field_list carries field_value (null when unset); 'group' is null when the entity has no row for the group. snake_case body. Errors: E1006 (required param missing), E1001 (unknown group_id or entity).

domain_entity_id.description: The entity id (a customer id when domain_entity_type is CUSTOMER).
